captions.detailed: A dual-jar commercial blender featuring a wide, light-gray pedestal base with rounded edges. It holds two identical, transparent, rectangular polycarbonate jars side-by-side, each equipped with a black vertical loop handle. At the top, each jar is sealed with a flat, black lid featuring a small central square cap, while inside, a four-blade steel assembly sits at the bottom of each container.
captions.instruction: Design a twin-jar commercial blender with a wide, rounded light-gray base, two side-by-side transparent square jars with black handles, and flat black lids, ensuring the blades inside the jars and the lids can rotate.
captions.factory: Construct the wide, tapered pedestal base using a lofted or extruded profile with filleted vertical corners. Model the transparent jars as hollowed-out rectangular prisms with thin walls, adding extruded handles on the outer faces. Create the rotating blades by intersecting and patterning thin rectangular solids on a central cylindrical shaft, and define the flat lids with central square caps, positioning them on revolute joints at the jar rims.
